title: Rooftop Oasis | Stylish Townhome | Karaoke
description:
This newly professionally designed 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse is the perfect home away from home for traveling couples, business travelers, and anyone seeking a temporary stay in Nashville.
